notes: renderer=software; pacing=60; frame_ms = interval between consecutive frame ends; frame end = first winit about_to_wait after a RedrawRequested (Slint renders and presents synchronously while handling RedrawRequested: softbuffer present_with_damage for software/skia-software, eglSwapBuffers for femtovg), observed through the public slint::winit_030::CustomApplicationHandler; set_rendering_notifier is not usable as frame end (AfterRendering fires before present, and the software renderer returns Unsupported). BENCH_PACING=60: native Slint cadence; redraw requested via slint::Window::request_redraw, Slint's winit X11 TimerBasedFrameThrottle fires a repeated Timer of 1000000/refresh_millihertz ms (integer ms: 16 ms at 60 Hz, i.e. 62.5 Hz) and calls winit request_redraw ; 2 s warm-up not recorded. canvas = one Slint Rectangle element per shape (no immediate-mode canvas API in Slint; repeater over VecModel, all rows set_row_data each frame), @linear-gradient background, drop-shadow-* on 1/10; graph = Path element, commands string rebuilt each frame (10000 pts); software renderer: drop-shadow not drawn (draw_box_shadow is a TODO), gradient + border-radius drawn square, clip ignores border-radius (all documented limits)

not_rendered: linear_gradient_with_border_radius (circles and rounded rects drawn as square gradients)
rounded_clip (clip of the rounded panel is rectangular)
